correctness.rationale: The simultaneous 1-WL step preserves and extends the capped ordered center/leaf distance pairs (min(d,t),min(e,t)) for each noncentral vertex: the unique degree≥3 center and degree-one leaves anchor the two directions. Middle-arm positions cease sharing capped pairs by ceil(L/2); leaves from distinct arm lengths a<b cease sharing pairs at a+1. Beyond max of these obstructions pairs equal exactly on automorphism orbits and no split can occur. This reconstructs the all-length proof and handles length-one, equal and repeated-length arms. Independent graph-generated refinement checked 1,242 arm multisets; finite checks corroborate rather than establish an infinite theorem. An earlier complete proof for the exact same general formula was separately inspected.

final_claim: For finite uncolored spider trees with ≥3 positive-length arms, the 1-WL stabilization round is ceil(L/2) for equal arms, otherwise max(ceil(L/2), B+1), where L and B are the largest and second-largest distinct arm lengths; intermediate capped-distance partitions and stable automorphism orbits are given.
